topics.title: Lucy's Final Broadcast
topics.summary: During a radio show, hosts discuss Lucy’s recent death and its impact. They recount details about the quiet funeral arranged by her family to avoid crowds, including Gary Morton’s desire for privacy following Marilyn Monroe’s experience. A caller shares unsettling experiences attempting to contact Lucy via telephone, describing her as still coughing and unresponsive, while others speculate on other celebrity deaths and media attention.

topics.title: Lucy's Grave Tour and Nutrisystem Obsession
topics.summary: A radio host recounts a bizarre encounter with a woman obsessively following Lucy’s grave, surrounded by armed guards and camera operators. She then details her experiences on the NutriSystem diet, including interactions with callers and anecdotes about her former weight and an unusual acquaintance – a ‘haemaphrodite’ radio personality.

topics.title: Radio Guests Clash Over French Culture
topics.summary: A radio broadcast devolves into a heated argument between hosts and a late-arriving French guest, Jim Hansen. The discussion quickly turns to criticisms of French music, attitudes toward tourists, historical relations with America, and personal insults directed at both the French and Americans.

topics.title: Polanski Debate & Radio Chaos
topics.summary: A radio broadcast descends into a chaotic discussion centered around Roman Polanski and his deportation. The conversation rapidly shifts to unrelated topics including French food preferences, American tourists, homosexuality in Paris, Rock Hudson’s death from AIDS, South African music requests, and critiques of the Parisian radio industry.

topics.title: Gay Club Dialogue & Song
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, hosts discuss encounters in gay clubs referencing anxieties about homosexuality and AIDS while recounting tourist interactions with Parisian women. A comedic song segment features absurd observations and commentary regarding personal behavior and societal norms.

topics.title: Stern Defends Ratings, Dismisses Criticism
topics.summary: Howard Stern discusses declining ratings and a critical article from Randall Bloomquist. He defends the show's popularity with younger listeners, arguing for fair compensation based on audience size despite initial low numbers, while dismissing criticism as stemming from returning to the air after five years.
